text:
Anya (pm): heads-up: planning call follow-up for the enterprise compliance bundle. main asks: audit-friendly export format, BYOK onboarding flow, legal-hold semantics, and retention tiers. dropping notes here so we can lock launch criteria.

Rachel (cs): two customer asks surfaced: 1) export must be ingestible by third-party e-discovery tools; 2) ability to pause deletion for legal hold with audit trail. both are blockers for procurement.

Sofia (security): propose a canonical export: compressed tarball with three files: metadata.json (manifest + signatures), logs.jsonl (audit events), ops.csv (key operation summary). manifest includes sha256 for each file and signing_key_id. require PoP (proof-of-possession) during BYOK enrollment.

Mia (legal): accepted formats preferred. add that manifest must include the legal-hold flag and timestamped justification text saved in immutable store. auditors need chain-of-custody notes.

Mark (eng-infra): infra constraints: export jobs must be asynchronous. we should provide pre-signed S3 URL for download and support streaming to customer-owned buckets. prefer per-tenant bucket for isolation but support shared-bucket + prefix for cost-sensitive customers. need idempotency and job status API.

Li (eng-runtime): runtime constraints: do NOT block inference if KMS unreachable. fallback strategy: use short-lived ephemeral wrapping keys generated locally, mark every token/response with X-Key-Source header. include a telemetry flag so we can filter ephemeral usage in observability. ephemeral TTL 60s default.

Ben (product): feature idea: Console shows onboarding progress + a test vector result (wrap/unwrap sample). acceptance test: wizard completes and shows green check for PoP and a sample export created.

Sofia (security): add to acceptance: every wrap/unwrap event logged with immutable seq_id, kms_response_code, and request_nonce. rotation events must include prior_key_id and rotation_reason.

Rachel (cs): for runbooks: emergency key rotation steps, how to generate an immediate evidence export, and customer-facing FAQs. I'll draft and attach example emails.

Mark (eng-infra): retention defaults proposal: standard = 90d, enterprise = 1y, gov = customizable (multi-year). legal-hold overrides automatic deletion; retention enforcement must check legal-hold flag atomically.

Mia (legal): we need an audit entry for every change to retention policy with actor and timestamp. also add an approval trace for any legal-hold lift.

Li (eng-runtime): low-level: add X-Key-Mode header values: "kms", "ephemeral", "hosted-fallback". also we should surface a metric: pct_requests_using_ephemeral_key.

Anya (pm): draft launch checklist items I'm hearing: onboarding wizard + PoP test; manifest schema & signed exports; per-tenant or prefixed-bucket decision; runtime fallback + header; legal-hold enforcement; runbook + support scripts; canary rollouts. who owns what?

Ben (product): I'll own product acceptance and the Console UX for the wizard.

Mark (eng-infra): infra handles export job API, bucket patterns, and idempotency.

Sofia (security): security owns manifest schema, PoP, and key-op log requirements.

Li (eng-runtime): runtime owns headers, fallback TTL config, and telemetry metrics.

Rachel (cs): support runbooks + customer comms. I'll gather two reference customers to validate retention tiers.

Mia (legal): I'll provide the required audit clauses and sample legal-hold wording.

Ben (product): quick pricing question: include basic export in enterprise plan, charge extra for long-term archival storage and for streaming to customer-owned buckets? open to sales input.

Rachel (cs): customers expect export included. archival and customer-bucket transfer can be premium.

Sofia (security): one security caveat: streaming to customer buckets requires validating we can verify delivery and integrity. include checksums and retry policy.

Mark (eng-infra): implementation note: export job flow: create job -> validate request (idempotency token) -> generate manifest -> stream to destination -> close job with status and signed manifest. jobs should expose progress % and estimated size.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: feature/byo-compliance -> staging on 2024-10-14T02:15Z :rocket:

Anya (pm): timeline: PoC for manifest & wizard by next Wed; canary to 5% within 2 weeks after PoC; sign-off meeting scheduled Fri 5pm PT. please add open risks to the epic.

Li (eng-runtime): open risk: quantization of logs could increase export size; may need sampling. flagging for infra.

Sofia (security): open risk: HSM providers vary on which metadata they return; manifest schema needs optional fields and normalization rules.

Anya (pm): noted. action items recap: Ben UX, Mark infra job + buckets, Sofia manifest + PoP, Li fallback + headers, Rachel runbook + pricing feedback, Mia legal text. I'll consolidate and post updated launch criteria.

Ben (product): thanks all. please react with :thumbsup: when your owner item is added to the epic.

Anya (pm): end of thread.
